entities.name: Kb'Briann Highlands
entities.description: A region on Dominaria in Aerona at the foot of the Hurloon Mountains, once controlled by the Order of the Closed Fist.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Highlands lie.

entities.name: Order of the Closed Fist
entities.description: A group that once controlled the Kb'Briann Highlands.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Nation to the north-west of the Highlands, whose protectorate the region's clans effectively are.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: Region east of the Highlands across the Suder River.

entities.name: Hurloon Mountains
entities.description: Mountains at whose foot the Highlands lie.

entities.name: Suder River
entities.description: River dividing the Highlands from Llanowar and the Durkwood.

entities.name: Durkwood
entities.description: A forest divided from the Highlands by the Suder River.

relations.note: The Order once controlled the region.
relations.quote: once controlled by the Order of the Closed Fist

relations.note: The Highlands are at the foot of the Hurloon Mountains on Aerona.
relations.quote: at the foot of the Hurloon Mountains on the continent of Aerona

relations.note: The region's warrior clans are effectively a Benalish protectorate.
relations.quote: The warrior clans of this region are effectively a Benalish protectorate.
